text:
pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT: SLA alert triggered for tenant 'StellarPay' — 5m rolling availability < 99.5%. Paging oncall group. (alert_id: pd-98432)

alex: Ack. I'm on it.

mohit: @alex any initial blast radius? is this across regions or one rack/pool?

pagerduty-bot: Alert details:
- check: tenant_sla_5m
- tenant_id: stellarpay-837
- region: us-east-1
- current_5m: 98.9%
- baseline_24h: 99.98%
- matching_requests: 12k in 5m
- triggered_rules: tenant-specific SLA check (sensitivity: medium)

alex: Looks like most errors are 5xx from inference pool g4dn-dedicated-02. Not a network-level spike.

lena: @alex can you dump sample 5xx logs? also any rate-limiter tripped on the tenant?

alex: grabbing logs. quick tail:
```
[2026-03-15T09:42:12Z] req_id=abcd12 tenant=stellarpay model=rwkv-13b variant=quantized status=503 backend_err=kv-cache-miss
[2026-03-15T09:42:13Z] req_id=abcd13 tenant=stellarpay model=gptx-7b status=200
[2026-03-15T09:42:14Z] req_id=abcd14 tenant=stellarpay model=rwkv-13b status=503 backend_err=kv-cache-full
```

alex: Patterns: 503s concentrated to rwkv-13b quantized variant, KV cache pressure appears. Other tenants on same pool unaffected (until now).

mohit: So this is tenant-specific noisy checks hitting cache limits → causing 503s and SLA breach. Good candidate for per-tenant throttling or cache-shed.

zoe (CSM): Customer-facing note: StellarPay reports errors to end-users. They're getting escalations. We need ETA for mitigation and plan to send to CS.

alex: Temporary mitigation steps I'm doing now:
- bump dedicated pool replica by 1 (if capacity available)
- enable fallback routing for stellarpay to use gptx-7b variant for 30m via routing policy `tenant:stellarpay -> fallback:gptx-7b`
- open a kv-cache pressure alert to observe after changes

ops-bot: autoscaler triggered add_instance(g4dn-dedicated-02) — request queued (est. 120s).

lena: Good. Also propose tuning the tenant-specific check: it's firing on single-minute blips. We should require sustained degradation (5m -> 15m) before paging.

mohit: Agreed. Suggested alert update (Prometheus-style snippet):
```
- alert: TenantSLA_Ramped
  expr: avg_over_time(tenant_success_rate{tenant="stellarpay-837"}[15m]) < 0.995
  for: 15m
  labels:
    severity: warning
    tenant: stellarpay-837
```
Change: increase window to 15m and require `for: 15m` to reduce noise from short bursts.

alex: +1. But we should be careful not to mask real outages. For now: add a silence on the current alert for this tenant for 30m (while mitigation active) and create a new non-paging alert for 5m anomalies so SRE can watch.

zoe (CSM): I'll draft a short customer message: "We're seeing transient backend errors; we've routed your requests to an alternative model and are adding capacity. Monitoring closely, ETA 30m."

mohit: I'll create follow-up tasks:
- add tenant-specific KV cache telemetry dashboard panel (per-tenant cache fill, evictions)
- add annotation in runbook: if evictions spike > 80% for 5m, reduce per-tenant cache weight or route to fallback
- review quantized variant memory config (possible bug)

alex: autoscaler finished, new instance in pool. Routing switch applied for StellarPay -> gptx-7b fallback. Initial success: 5m success up to 99.6% (observed 2m after change).

ops-bot: silence created: alert=tenant_sla_5m tenant=stellarpay-837 duration=30m by=user=alex

lena: Nice. For post-incident clean up:
- Update tenant_sla alert to use 15m window (mohit to PR)
- Add non-paging short-window alert for ops dashboard (alex)
- Create dashboard panels and an alert for KV cache evictions (mohit)
- Runbook note: add explicit steps to enable tenant routing fallback (lena)
- CSM follow-up message (zoe)

mohit: I'll open the PR now: title: "eng: reduce tenant SLA pager sensitivity & add kv-cache telemetry". Draft of diff in case useful: 
```diff
- expr: avg_over_time(tenant_success_rate[5m]) < 0.995
- for: 1m
+ expr: avg_over_time(tenant_success_rate[15m]) < 0.995
+ for: 15m
+ annotations:
+  runbook: https://redwood/infra/runbooks/tenant-sla
```

alex: Heads-up for oncall handoff: I'll be online for ~20 more minutes. After that handing to @lena. Notes: silenced current pager, capacity added, fallback routing active, watch kv-cache evictions panel.

lena: Taking over. Thanks @alex — I'll watch the dashboard and coordinate with infra if eviction rate climbs again.

zoe (CSM): Sending update to customer now. I'll include ETA and that we're performing post-incident analysis.

ops-bot: alert tenant_sla_5m resumed at 1801007123 (silence expired).

lena: Post-mortem actions (summary):
- Modify alert window -> PR #3421 (mohit)
- Add KV cache eviction metrics + dashboards (mohit)
- Add tenant routing fallback step to runbook (lena)
- Investigate quantized variant mem config and possible leak (alex)
- Schedule meeting with StellarPay if they want deeper RCA (zoe)

mohit: I'll follow-up on PR and add unit tests for the alert rule to ensure no false negative on long outages.

alex: Closing the paging loop. SLA back above threshold after mitigation. Will add logs and a short timeline to the postmortem doc.

lena: Thanks all. If we see reoccurrence, escalate to platform reliability.

zoe (CSM): Customer wants a brief RCA in 24h. I'll coordinate.

pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: pd-98432 — resolved 1801007123 (duration ~46m).
